title: events.earnings payload
description: One earnings event. Published when scheduled (actuals null) and again when actuals arrive. event_id is stable across both. Consensus must be as-of the day before the report (no look-ahead); EPS is as-reported, never restated.

timing.description: Before market open / after market close. Determines day 0.

timing_sources.description: Every vendor consulted. Timing is only trusted when two vendors agree; otherwise UNKNOWN.

eps_consensus_asof.description: Date the consensus snapshot was taken. Must be <= report_date - 1.

next_report_date.description: Next scheduled earnings, for the earnings-gate exit.

material_8k_dates.description: Dates of 8-K filings other than the earnings release, as known at as_of_utc.
